_README: OPTIONAL — attach these SFN-role statements ONLY IF you deploy the optional MRL fleet state machine (deploy_mrl.sh --with-fleet-sm). The DEFAULT MRL deployment needs NO IAM change: the existing <project>-lambda-exec-role / <project>-sfn-exec-role / <project>-glue-exec-role already cover every call the MRL Lambdas, Glue jobs and the mrl-task state machine make (proven by tests/test_existing_iam_covers_mrl.py). The ONLY thing the existing SFN role does NOT grant is the fleet machine's parent->child hand-off (states:startExecution.sync:2 on <project>-mrl-task) and its nested-execution managed event rule. If you instead start tasks with tools/mrl_fleet_run.py (the default), you do not need this file at all. Fill <account-id>, <region>, <project>.
